answer: Hardware remote attestation resists Sybil attacks by requiring each agent to bind its session key inside a secure enclave and submit a quote chained to a vendor root, giving validators an authentic provenance signal. Grounding identity in unique silicon etched like basalt rather than a cosmetic software pigment forces an attacker to buy separate physical hardware per identity. However, side-channel key extraction or a compromised vendor root still enables forged clones.
